risks.risk: Bike may not actually be road-ready (engine starting, idle stability, charging, or battery health not proven).
risks.proof: Short video of a cold start + rev test + headlight/indicator/brake light working, and a quick ride showing smooth gear changes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven road-ready (worst case: needs basic checks/repairs).

risks.risk: Braking system condition unknown (pads/shoes/disc wear, brake fluid leaks, or weak braking).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear brake components + a clip braking from low speed showing strong stop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes not confirmed (worst case: may need brake service).

risks.risk: Gear shifting/clutch condition unknown (slipping clutch, hard shifting, missing gears).
risks.proof: Video of gear changes in motion (1st to top gear) and a stop-and-go test showing no slipping.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gears/clutch not confirmed (worst case: may need clutch/gear adjustment).

risks.risk: Originality and hidden corrosion/repairs unknown (frame/engine underside not visible; possible replacement parts).
risks.proof: Underbody/frame close-ups + engine number/part number photos (where applicable) and receipts if any.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown originality/condition (worst case: may have replaced parts).

risks.risk: Registration/plate authenticity and legal status not confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full plate + any papers (ownership/receipt) and VIN/engine number match (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as legal status not confirmed (worst case: may require paperwork).

proof_requests: Video: cold start + headlight/indicators + horn + brake light test.
Video: low-speed ride showing smooth gear changes and strong braking.
Close-up photos of front and rear brake components (pads/shoes/disc) and any brake fluid/lines.
Close-up photos of engine area and underbody/frame for rust/leaks + odometer reading.
Clear photos of engine number/VIN (if present) and any purchase/ownership documents.
response.reason: The photos identify an AX100-style underbone motorcycle, but the seller’s key claims (road-ready, brakes/gears perfect, no rust, original parts, battery condition) are not verifiable from images alone. Request start/ride/brake proof before pricing confidently.
